HOW TO READ THIS MODEL

The visible part of an invisible process.

Selection and the 2-second automatic start follow your observations. During a running cycle, Function/Cancel reproduces your reported unsuccessful cancellation; use Unplug to stop. Lid position is a simulated interlock. Internal sequences, temperatures, sensor placement, and preset timing are illustrative—not verified Koja specifications or cooking instructions. “Complete” means the demo program ended, not that real food is safe or cooked.

See the logic & scope

State is stored as power, lidAligned, selectedMode, status, temperature, stageIndex, elapsed, and presetHours. Click and change events update these variables. Conditional rules block a misaligned lid, select a program, and control heat and motion. The selected program supplies a series of stages; simulated time advances them. Turning the lid during operation stops the model as an illustrative safety rule.

The redesigned version is reserved for later: guided weighing, optional explanations, and saved texture preferences. Extra labels on the reference photograph (Thick Soymilk and Complementary Food) are not modeled in this first version.
